comment: Exact resolved build-time dependencies. The fixture has no third-party runtime dependency — nothing under src/ imports outside the Node standard library — so this list covers only what is needed to compile the TypeScript and run the test suite.
notes: tree/package-lock.json is the authority: it carries the resolved URL and subresource integrity hash for each package, and the image installs with `npm ci`, which fails rather than re-resolving if the lock and the manifest disagree.
The base image is pinned by digest in fixture.yaml; the Dockerfile takes it as a build argument so the pin lives in one place.
Unlike fx-taskq-py, the image build does consult a registry. The pin that makes it reproducible is the lockfile's integrity hashes, not the absence of a network step.
